"""Tests API P0 pour health et healthcheck (complément couverture critique)."""
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


@pytest.fixture
def client():
    from api.main import app
    return TestClient(app)


class TestHealthP0:
    """[P0] Health endpoints - chemins critiques monitoring/déploiement."""

    def test_health_returns_200_and_status_healthy(self, client: TestClient):
        """[P0] GET /health doit retourner 200 et status healthy."""
        response = client.get("/health")
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        assert data.get("status") == "healthy"
        assert "timestamp" in data
        assert "service" in data

    def test_healthcheck_alias_returns_200(self, client: TestClient):
        """[P0] GET /api/v1/healthcheck (alias) doit retourner 200."""
        response = client.get("/api/v1/healthcheck")
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        assert data.get("status") == "healthy"

    def test_health_detailed_returns_200_with_details(self, client: TestClient):
        """[P1] GET /health/detailed doit retourner 200 et détails optionnels."""
        response = client.get("/health/detailed")
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        assert "status" in data or "healthy" in str(data).lower()

    def test_health_response_has_expected_structure(self, client: TestClient):
        """[P1] Réponse health a structure attendue pour monitoring."""
        response = client.get("/health")
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        assert isinstance(data, dict)
        assert "status" in data
